revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, slightly distant oblique medium-wide view, realistic scale and natural perspective. A realistic staff break room with large neutral floor tiles and neutral indoor illumination, ordinary furniture, and a comfortable sofa clearly supporting a consenting adult actor reclining normally on the sofa in a relaxed rest pose. The scene should look like a plausible unedited inspection-camera capture with enough surrounding context to judge body support. Include a safety rail in the room and a distant worker-shaped silhouette that is not the subject. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, neutral colors, no cinematic or advertising look. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or artificial annotation.
